name: John Peehn
role: Billings County homesteader whose entry was contested
bio: John Peehn held a homestead entry dated April 9, 1883, in Billings County, which John Weber contested at the Bismarck land office in July 1884 for abandonment. The contest notice, summoning both men to a hearing on August 21, 1884, ran in the Cow Boy that summer.
